XenotypeDef.label: Bernael
XenotypeDef.description: Spawned directly by the supreme archotech Caligo, the creator of psycasts, the Bernaels are the ancient, true wielders of the psychic echo. They possess the innate ability to directly extract and consume raw psychic essence - the lingering souls of living beings - to fuel their formidable psionic abilities and sustain their existence. This predatory nature makes them the mortal enemies of the Empire, who view them as ungodly monstrosities beyond control. The Bernaels look upon the Nephilim with deep contempt, seeing them as hollow imperial puppets drinking a chemical substitute and wielding a stolen, bastardized version of their own primordial power. Yet despite their bitter hatred, both xenotypes are merely two sides of the same psychic coin. If a Bernael ceases devouring living souls and instead regularly consumes concentrated Grace Vials, the synthetic substance will bind the wild psychic ether within their body, stabilizing their mind and elevating the wild predator back into a luminous Nephilim.
